title: Pet Fee Ceiling on Roamhaven Listings — Policy Card and Pet Fee Reset Tool
content:
# Pet Fee Ceiling and the Pet Fee Reset

*Host Support card for Roamhaven Listings.*

## The policy this card serves

A listing's pet fee — the fee charged once per stay with pets — may be no higher than the listing's pet-fee ceiling. A pet fee standing above that ceiling is reset to the ceiling exactly, and the reset is logged as one change of the pet fee. A pet fee at or below the ceiling is left as it stands.

| Pet fee on the listing compared with the listing's pet-fee ceiling | Handling |
|---|---|
| above the ceiling | reset to the ceiling exactly; one change of the pet fee is logged |
| equal to the ceiling | left as it stands |
| below the ceiling | left as it stands |

**Effect of a reset.** From the reset onward, new bookings of the listing are priced with the reset pet fee; stays already booked keep the pet fee frozen on them. The host sees the new pet fee on the listing and the change in its history.

## Support tool: `reset_pet_fee_f8e15273`

**Capability.** Overwrites the per-stay pet fee of one host listing with the amount passed in. When that amount differs from the pet fee the listing carried at the moment of the call, one fee-change record is added to the listing's history with the old amount, the new amount and today's date; an amount equal to the one already carried changes nothing and logs nothing.

**How it is invoked.** The tool is an agent-side tool: support unlocks `reset_pet_fee_f8e15273` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `listing_id` | the reference number of the host listing whose pet fee is reset, as returned by the listing lookup for the verified host | the listing reference number |
| `pet_fee` | the pet fee charged once per stay with pets | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before saving; 0.00 means pets are not charged |

**Return.** A receipt carrying:

- `listing_id` — the listing reference number;
- `setting` — always `pet_fee`;
- `previous_amount` — the pet fee the listing carried when the call was made, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `new_amount` — the pet fee now saved, USD to 2 decimal places;
- `change_logged` — true when a fee-change record was added;
- `change_record_id` — the reference number of that record, empty when nothing was logged;
- `saved_on` — the date of the save, YYYY-MM-DD.

The call has completed when the receipt comes back with the listing reference number and the new amount; a receipt carrying the new amount means the reset is in force.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `listing_id` set to a listing reference number and `pet_fee` set to 120.00, on a listing that carried 150.00, returns `previous_amount` 150.00, `new_amount` 120.00, `change_logged` true and a `change_record_id`. The same call made again returns `change_logged` false and an empty `change_record_id`, because the amount no longer differs.
